source: CAMFAD student thesis: "Establishment of a New Coconut Plantation Farm", National School of Agriculture, July 1994. Note: individual line-item dollar figures in this source's tables are printed in dense, small-numeral Khmer script and were only partially legible in this scan; category totals given here should be treated as approximate best-effort readings, not verified exact figures.
text:
The thesis includes a detailed start-up cost estimate (in US dollars) for establishing the pilot plantation and its support facilities, broken into several categories: site/land-clearing costs for each building area (office, warehouse, fence, worker housing, well, kitchen and other buildings) plus site equipment (glazing, water pipe of three diameters, and a water tower); buildings and office equipment (roughly 19 line items covering desks, chairs, cabinets, a clock, fan, lamps, calculators, typewriters, bicycles, a motorbike, staff furniture, a generator, and radio/telephone equipment); land-clearing, well-digging, and planting-material costs; a 10-year staffing cost projection covering a director, deputy/assistant staff, general staff, field workers, warehouse/storage workers, security guards, a mechanic/technician, and a receptionist/cleaner, each with a monthly base wage plus insurance and savings contribution percentages; and fertilizer purchase and equipment costs.

Order of magnitude, as best read from the scan: site and site-equipment costs together run to roughly USD 150,000-200,000; buildings and office furnishing costs to roughly USD 180,000; the 10-year cumulative labor cost across all staff and worker categories is projected at roughly USD 2.4-2.5 million; land-clearing/well/planting-material costs are in the tens of thousands of dollars; and fertilizer costs are a few thousand dollars per year. These figures are for the smaller pilot farm site described elsewhere in this thesis (roughly 10-12 hectares along the coastal road in Preah Sihanouk), not the larger 10,000-hectare scenario used in the separate 10-year production/revenue forecast (see coconut/production_revenue_forecast_10yr in this knowledge base).
